title: Democrats lead by nine points: what Ukraine stands to gain if Trump loses Congress
lead: Americans elect a new Congress on 3 November. Democrats lead the national polls by 8–9 points, more than before 2018, when they gained 41 seats. Three scenarios for the White House, Trump’s powers and US support for Ukraine — pick one and see what changes.
imageAlt: Illustration: waves of ribbons in the colours of the US and Ukrainian flags at dawn. A central sign reads “What if Democrats win? Changes to Ukraine?”, surrounded by smaller signs: “Sanctions”, “Impeachment?”, “Overriding a veto?”, “What Congress controls”, “Most Senate legislation”, “The budget and the debt ceiling”, “Subpoenas, hearings, investigations”
